suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require documented rhegmatogenous retinal detachment treated with pars plana vitrectomy, with or without scleral buckle as applicable, in an eye that was phakic at the relevant surgical exposure, followed by separately documented postoperative cataract development or progression. PMID 39541379 supports increased cataract progression after PPV-based RRD surgery compared with certain alternative surgical approaches; do not infer cataract from untreated retinal detachment, do not generalize this source to unrelated retinal-detachment phenotypes, and do not apply a cataract-progression pathway to an eye already pseudophakic before the relevant surgery. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment/procedure exposure for Retinal Detachment
Independent diagnosis of Cataracts and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and exact source-phenotype fit
